title: G 7986 SCVi AutoDos K2O Dishwasher
sub: Fully integrated and panel ready, handleless with Knock2open
lead: Miele's fully integrated dishwasher for a kitchen without handles: knock on the front and the door opens. It sits behind your own cabinet panel and is shown here with a plain white one.

features.name: Knock2open
features.line: No handle to interrupt the cabinetry. Knock on the front and the door opens by itself.

features.name: AutoDos with PowerDisk
features.line: The dishwasher dispenses its own detergent from a PowerDisk, load after load. One disk is included, with a voucher for six more.

features.name: AutoOpen drying
features.line: At the end of the cycle the door opens by itself, and the load finishes drying in fresh air.

features.name: Quiet at 39 dB(A)
features.line: Rated at 39 dB(A), and 37 on the Extra Quiet program, for a kitchen that opens onto the living room.

features.name: Tested for 20 years of use
features.line: In development Miele ran this series through 5,600 wash cycles, the equivalent of 280 loads a year for 20 years.

also: M Touch display: a large touch display you swipe through
AutoClose: a light press and the door draws itself shut
BrilliantLight: four LEDs light the interior as the door opens
3D MultiFlex Tray with three glass holders and a cup rack
QuickIntenseWash: 58 minutes for normally soiled dishes
Miele@home Wi-Fi, there if you want it
specs: Fully integrated, takes a custom cabinet panel
